pages.text: Luna, a black dog, sat in Picnic Meadow. Her red collar held a brass tag. Pip, a brown hare, tied a green ribbon on his wrist. They were ready for a fun picnic.
Pip spread out his favourite picnic blanket on the soft grass. Luna set down the tasty snacks. They smiled and sat together in the warm sun.
Whoosh! A strong gust of wind lifted the blanket high into the air. Luna and Pip saw the wind blow the blanket toward Flower Path. They ran after it quickly.
The wind blew the blanket past Flower Path and right over Pond Bridge. Luna and Pip ran across the wooden bridge, but the blanket flew higher and higher.
The blanket stuck in the high branches of Tall Oak. Luna said, "Together, we find a way!" She asked Pip to climb while she waited below to catch it.
Pip shouted, "Leap, look, and go!" Pip used his quick, accurate hops across safe gaps between the low branches. He reached the blanket and pushed it down safely.
Luna caught the falling blanket with her paws. Pip hopped down from the tree. They both cheered because their soft blanket was safe again.
Luna and Pip walked back to Picnic Meadow. They spread the blanket on the green grass again. The black dog and brown hare happily enjoyed their tasty picnic.
